reviews.title: To many updates/logins
reviews.text:
Every single time I need this app it wants an update which I then have to try and pull down in the middle of a power outage over cellular. And then it logs me out and I and do a whole song and dance with log password recovery. 

I am taking everyone’s advice and replacing my Mobile Link interface with an aftermarket unit.

reviews.title: Reduce size of Premium Mobile Link Warning
reviews.text: The size of the premium Mobile Link expired notice is obnoxious! I get you really want people to sign up for it, but this isn’t the way. I have no problem with you keeping it there front and top center. Please reduce the size so I can see more on the screen without having to scroll down.

reviews.title: Unreliable.
reviews.text:
It doesn’t support 5ghz which is no big deal so I try to set it up with my 2.4ghz WiFi network.  I am 100% sure the password is correct. Nothing. 

So I go back to cellular. Well it says the generator is working and online and a green check but I am suspicious because the temperature reflects 10 degrees warmer than it really is with sunny conditions. 

I have tried turning Bluetooth on and off and my phone on and off  as well as closing and opening the app but still I have no confidence then when we are away this will work.  

I generously give it two stars because it did work for a while and when it does it has a lot of useful information. 

When it does work. Sigh.

reviews.title: Still?
reviews.text: I don’t know why generac can’t just hire a 14 year old to do some programming for its app. It’s interfaces and usefulness continue to lag behind. The update to 3.19 was supposed to fix problem with ability to set up connectivity device (mobile link lte device) with a WiFi back up, but it still does not work. Been on phone with support for hours. No resolution and just ridiculous script reading and nonsense responses. And while I’m at it, why can’t Generac add a simple function to the app to be able to remotely turn the generator off and on?!  Again, there are plenty of 14 year olds looking for an after school job, although that type of programming would only take them an hour or so!

reviews.text: The warranty will not show it keeps kicking you out if the app

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: There are several issues with the app. First, when creating a new account, I got an error message stating that it could not create an account and to try again later. Since it uses ecobee authentication, it should have said an account already exists and that the user should sign in using ecobee credentials. Second, there appear to be no instructions from generac directing you to the app or how to use it. Third, you should be able to add alternate emails and notifications on the notification page, but I could not find an option to do so.

reviews.title: No Longer “Set it and forget it”!
reviews.text: I purchased my Generac for safety AND convenience. While I would prefer that no unauthorized individual access its data, it is NOT a major security concern. The decision, by Generac, to require regular password changes and thus create connectivity issues, very negatively impacts the convenience factor while “solving” a security issue about which I am very minimally concerned. This change is, to me, a bad one with little benefit and appreciable impact on my product satisfaction. Forcing residential users to rotate passwords on a piece of outdoor backup hardware is major overkill. Generac’s rigid new security protocol treats this like a high-risk attack vector. News flash, it’s not! The overall effect has been to turn a piece of premium, "set-it-and-forget-it" safety equipment into a high-maintenance chore. I would give it a zero rating if I could!
